notes: Game Bot V0.08: AMD unlocked - NVIDIA RTX 20 series or newer, or AMD RX 6000 series or newer (Vulkan), 8 GB VRAM minimum, 12 GB recommended (RX 5000 runs with a may-be-unstable note). Smarter chat: messages that are not a command get a real answer, a concrete proposal you confirm with yes, or one clear question instead of a canned build-stage reply; it never claims a change it has not made, and feedback like the gun feels weak gets specific damage, fire-rate, recoil, muzzle flash, sound and hit-feedback options for your game.
